verdict: Cloudflare grew revenue 34% to $615M and narrowed its GAAP net loss to $12M — the operating loss was $49M, softened by $42M of interest income on its cash pile.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted net loss per share, vs -$0.04 a year ago

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: 16% of revenue; operating cash flow was $190M

kpis.label: Non-GAAP operating income
kpis.note: a 15% margin, vs a $49M GAAP operating loss

segments.name: Cloudflare platform
segments.note: One connectivity cloud: network, security and developer services sold mostly as subscriptions. Cloudflare reports a single segment.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and winning customers; includes $36.038M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes, and $0.659M of amortization of acquired intangible assets.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and new products (R&D); includes $46.947M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office (G&A); includes $45.391M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes, $3.797M of acquisition-related and other expenses and $1.257M of lease impairment charges, partly offset by a $2.886M legal reserve release.

follow100Note: Cloudflare spends $40.87 of every $100 on selling — its go-to-market machine is the biggest single running cost.
otherDetail: Non-operating income of $39M net was $42M of interest income on Cloudflare's cash and securities, plus a small amount of other items, minus $3M of interest expense (mostly amortization of debt issuance costs) and $0.3M of other expense, net.
footerNote: Stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes totaled $132M in the quarter across all lines — the main gap between the GAAP loss and non-GAAP profit.

takeaways.title: Growth re-accelerated into year-end
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 34% to $615M. Cloudflare closed its largest annual-contract-value deal ever (about $42.5M a year), total new ACV grew nearly 50%, and remaining performance obligations grew 48%.

takeaways.title: Non-GAAP profit vs GAAP loss
takeaways.text: Non-GAAP operating income was $90M, a 15% margin. The GAAP operating loss of $49M is after $132M of stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes in the quarter.

takeaways.title: Cash flow doubled
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $99M, 16% of revenue, up from $48M a year ago; Cloudflare ended 2025 with $4,101M of cash and available-for-sale securities.
